$comment: builtin__trigger_create payload for IronClaw 1.4.0 (execution_contract schema, verified against the binary on 2026-09-17). Deferred tools return their schema on first call — call trigger_create twice if the first reply carries a 'note' asking to call again.
name: jyotish-nightly-consensus

execution_contract.goal: Run the Jyotish-OS nightly engine consensus check: call mcp-jyotish-local__engine__consensus exactly once with {"birth": {"utc": "1990-03-15T06:30:00Z", "lat": 28.6139, "lon": 77.2090, "tz_offset_hours": 5.5}} (the GOLDEN chart from docs/CONTRACT.md). If consensus_status is PASS reply with the single word PASS. If it is FAIL, SIDECAR_UNAVAILABLE, or any error, reply with a message starting 'jyotish consensus FAIL' followed by the raw per-body deltas or error text.
success_criteria: The reply is PASS, or starts with 'jyotish consensus FAIL' and includes the raw deltas/error
execution_contract.output_instructions: Either the single word PASS or 'jyotish consensus FAIL: ...' with raw tool output.
execution_contract.no_result_text: jyotish consensus FAIL: engine.consensus returned no result.
